title: Potential NoneType error in get_response
detail: When get_response is called with the default environ=None, the code skips the Request check and later uses environ as a dict. This will raise a TypeError when accessing environ keys, causing the response generation to crash.

title: Incorrect name resolution for HTTPException subclasses
detail: The code now only attempts to set the exception name from HTTPStatus if the subclass already has a non-empty name. Subclasses that rely on the default empty name will never get a proper HTTPStatus phrase, leading to missing or incorrect status names in error responses.
note: Describes the planted negation: the name is filled in only when there already is one.

title: Incorrect no_proxy matching logic
detail: The added logic strips leading dots and then immediately returns True if the hostname does not equal the stripped host or the host_with_port equals the stripped host. This causes URLs that should not bypass proxies (e.g., "http://newdomain.com/" when no_proxy contains "newdomain.com:1234") to be incorrectly bypassed, breaking expected proxy behavior.
note: Describes the planted flip: a host that doesn't match bypasses the proxy.

title: Unawaited coroutine in load queue
detail: load_queue is an asyncio.Queue; get() returns a coroutine that must be awaited. Calling it without await returns a coroutine object, causing the loader to process a coroutine instead of a Path and likely block or crash.
